technical.summary: Extreme oversold conditions present but lack recovery confirmation; death cross, price below all short-term MAs, weak ADX, and negative MACD histogram create conflicting signals unsuitable for high-probability swing entry.

fundamental.summary: UPS shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and faces earnings in 63 days with elevated risk.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (22/100) presents contrarian opportunity; senior Republican McCaul accumulated $115k-$150k across three purchases (most recent 172 days ago); lack of recent news data limits confirmation but congressional buying + market panic suggests potential accumulation phase.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (373.76) dominates risk assessment; normal yield curve provides limited offset; earnings in 63 days adds moderate event risk; macro_score of -1 confirms unfavourable conditions.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme oversold RSI conditions (9 & 14), PSAR bullish signal, Supertrend bullish, and congressional insider accumulation by senior member in fear-zone environment create contrarian setup with price near support (171.41).
debate.key_bear_argument: Death cross, price below all short-term MAs, negative MACD histogram, weak ADX trend structure (17.56), below-average volume, no momentum confirmation on RSI recovery, and crisis-level VIX (373.76) in unfavourable macro environment eliminate high-probability entry despite oversold conditions.

decision.primary_risk: Crisis-level VIX (373.76) and unfavourable macro environment create systemic downside risk that overshadows technical oversold bounce potential; earnings in 63 days add event uncertainty.
